Privacy Policy

This privacy policy explains how Social Security Bronx handles information collected through this website.

Information we collect

We collect standard server logs (IP address, browser, pages visited, timestamps) automatically for site operation and security. We do not ask for or store personal data such as your name, Social Security number, or contact details unless you voluntarily contact us.

Analytics and advertising

We use standard analytics to understand site usage. We may display advertising from third parties (including Google AdSense), which may use cookies to serve relevant ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You can opt out of personalized advertising through the relevant ad networks.

Cookies

This site may use cookies for site functionality, analytics, and advertising. You can disable cookies in your browser settings; some site features may not work without them.

Your privacy and the SSA

Social Security Bronx does not collect, store or transmit your Social Security number, banking information, or other sensitive personal data. Never enter sensitive personal information into any third-party site claiming to be the SSA. Official services are only at ssa.gov.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact us via the contact page.
